label: Kongming system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Kongming locus that uses phage-triggered deoxyinosine triphosphate signaling to activate a KomBC effector complex and mediate NAD depletion-linked death of infected cells.
observations: dITP-signaling phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from system-encoded adenosine deaminases, phage nucleotide kinases, KomB or KomC proteins, the KomBC effector complex, dITP immune messengers, NAD depletion or infected-cell death by themselves, individual DefenseFinder HMM profiles, and missing DefenseFinder rule rows.
